### Module Pattern (all follow this)
```python
import threading, time, re
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

_INSTANCES: Dict[str, "ClassName"] = {}
_LOCK = threading.Lock()

class ClassName:
    def __init__(self, session_id="default"): ...
    def build_injection(self, context="") -> str: ...
    def get_stats(self) -> Dict: ...

def get_instance(session_id="default") -> ClassName:
    with _LOCK:
        if session_id not in _INSTANCES:
            _INSTANCES[session_id] = ClassName(session_id)
        return _INSTANCES[session_id]
```
